subject: Mental Models
title: BATNA
description: A quick, practical guide to BATNA.

hook.text: An employee with three job offers negotiates confidently. Another with no alternatives accepts whatever is offered.

buildup.text: BATNA is your Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement.

discovery.text: Roger Fisher and William Ury coined BATNA in Getting to Yes in 1981.

twist.text: Most people try to strengthen their arguments. Skilled negotiators strengthen their BATNA instead.

climax.text: Before any negotiation, define your BATNA. Then improve it. The better your alternative, the less you need this deal.

punchline.text: Your walkaway option sets your real power.

quiz.question: What does BATNA stand for?
options: Best Approach To Negotiation and Agreement
Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement
Basic Agreement Terms and Negotiation Actions
